[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} '''Brotherhood officers''' and '''petty officers''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy}} These are officers of various ranks in the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]]. They lead the chapter's non-power armored [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|Brotherhood soldiers]] taking part in military actions. Their uniform consists of red coats and blue scarves. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===Season 1=== ====[[The End (episode)|The End]]==== At the [[Brotherhood base]], a Brotherhood officer watches as an [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirant]] raises the Brotherhood of Steel flag. Later, after the [[Knight (TV series)|knights']] arrival at the airbase, Brotherhood officer [[Shortsight]] and another officer watch as a [[Scribe (TV series)|scribe]] listens to an officer feed him information over the radio about a [[Siggi Wilzig|target]]. Afterward, Shortsight and another officer approach Maximus and Dane in the warehouse where the [[T-60 power armor]] units were stored and inform Dane that they have been summoned. The day after Dane was chosen to become a [[Squire (TV series)|squire]], Shortsight investigates the cause of Dane's leg injury and finds a razor inside their boot. The blame is pinned on Maximus, who is later led by Shortsight and another officer to be interrogated, and they pass by a couple of officers overseeing a couple of aspirants' training. Standing outside of the interrogation location, was another officer armed with a [[Battle rifle (TV series)|battle rifle]]. After unhooding Maximus and placing it on a table beside Elder Cleric Quintus, Shortsight would leave. When Maximus visits Dane in the medical tent, Brotherhood officers are seen working in another tent juxtaposed to the medical tent. Many officers stand and listen to Elder Cleric Quintus' and Shortsight alerts [[Thaddeus]] to pass out the [[Siggi Wilzig|target]] and his [[CX404|companion]] papers. They then watch as the knights and their new squires fly off in their [[vertibird]]s. ====[[The Head]]==== Eventually, Shortsight contacts Titus, and Maximus answers in his place and covers up the fact that the real Titus had died by an [[Yao guai (TV series)|abomination]] by stating his squire died by it. An officer technician from the Brotherhood of Steel base assisted Shortsight with his communications, and a few other officers worked in the background. ====[[The Beginning]]==== [[File:Brotherhood officer 7 The Beginning.png|thumb|A Brotherhood officer during the [[Battle of Griffith Observatory]]]] Multiple Brotherhood officers attend Maximus' hearing, where he delivered the [[Critic|fake head]]. While the [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|Brotherhood soldiers]] prepare for the invasion of the [[New California Republic|NCR]] [[Griffith Observatory|base]]. Two officers rally the soldiers to move on to their vertibirds. Upon landing at the observatory, the Brotherhood officers fight alongside their Brotherhood army knights and soldiers. Breaching into the observatory, several knights, officers including Shortsight, and soldiers are accosted by [[the Ghoul]]. After the Ghoul kills one of the knights by exploiting its fatal flaw. Several knights were then killed after one knight unintentionally destroyed a power generator, creating a blackout and an opportunity for the Ghoul to kill several knights and officers. ===Season 2=== ====[[The Golden Rule]]==== {{section|FOTV}} ====[[The Profligate]]==== {{section|FOTV}} ====[[The Demon in the Snow]]==== {{section|FOTV}} ==Notes== Maximus, who has become a knight by the time of the second season of the TV series, is seen wearing an officer's coat in the second season. ==Appearances== Unnamed Brotherhood officers appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101|3=103|8=108|10=202|11=203}} ==Behind the scenes== * Actor [[Brendan Burke]] portrays Petty Officer Shortsight. [[Kenneth James Yuille]] is credited as a "commanding officer" in "The Beginning." Other unnamed officers are portrayed by stunt performers and uncredited extras. * Apart from Shortsight, no officer's rank is specifically identified in the series. However, some performers have used ranks in their self-credits; Alireza Mirmontazeri's credit is given as a "Brotherhood colonel," while Jonah Falcon identifies his character as "second in command." ===Actors=== ;Credited actors (season 1) * [[Kenneth James Yuille]] ;Stunt performers (season 1) * [[Calvin Ahn]] * [[Frank Bal]] ;Uncredited extras (season 1) * [[Alireza Mirmontazeri]] * [[Jared Glen Palmer]] * [[Jonah Falcon]] ;Uncredited extras (season 2) * [[Evan Shafran]] ==Gallery== ===Identified performers=== BOS officer - Alireza Mirmontazeri.jpg|[[Alireza Mirmontazeri]] ("[[The End (episode)|The End]]") Brotherhood officer Palmer.png|[[Jared Glen Palmer]] ("The End") Fallout JonahFalcon.jpg|[[Jonah Falcon]] ("[[The Beginning]]") Brotherhood officer 5 The Beginning.png|[[Kenneth James Yuille]] ("The Beginning") Brotherhood officer 6 The Beginning.png|[[Frank Bal]] ("The Beginning") Brotherhood officer Evan Shafran.png|[[Evan Shafran]] ("[[The Golden Rule]]") ===Unknown performers=== Brotherhood officer 1 The End.png|("The End") Brotherhood officer 2 The End.png|("The End") Bearded Brotherhood officer 1 The End.png|("The End") Bearded Brotherhood officer 2 The End.png|("The End") Bald Brotherhood officer 1 The End.png|("The End") Bald Brotherhood officer 2 The End.png|("The End") Brotherhood officer 1 The Head.png|("[[The Head]]") Brotherhood officer 2 The Beginning.png|("The Beginning") Brotherhood officer 3 The Beginning.png|("The Beginning") Brotherhood officer 4 The Beginning.png|("The Beginning") Brotherhood officer 1 The Beginning.png|("The Beginning") Brotherhood officer 8 The Beginning.png|("The Beginning") {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]]
